_meta.purpose: Labelled pairs of real items from docs/data/items.json (2026-11-14) for the story-clustering rules in regwatch_sources/dedupe.py.
_meta.sampling: all pairs within 10 days whose normalised titles have word Jaccard >= 0.25 or containment >= 0.5 (791 pairs), up to 9 drawn per Jaccard band of 0.1 with random.seed(7)
_meta.labelling_rule: same_story = both items report the same event or the same publication (syndicated copies, several outlets on one announcement, an act and its OJ/CELEX double). Different legal acts are never the same story, even with near-identical boilerplate titles; suspension vs reopening of trading are different events.
_meta.labelled_by: scraper-v2 agent, 2026-11-14, before the identifier rules were added
